tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 11th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 11th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered in this part of life. You refuse to belong to the group on its terms; raw nonconformity in community and friendship. Idealistic and highly selective about friends and groups; risks over-demanding others and feeling betrayed. Wants to make a unique contribution, but needs realism so perfectionism doesn't deliver nothing.
business: The disowned self activates through friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures. A principled voice that won't be absorbed by the crowd.
shadow: Alienation from groups, or burning bridges with allies.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 11th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with friendship, networks, community, hopes, and collective futures directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
